HOME.TITLE: Find Your Specialist

ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: At CuraSlot, we're dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality access to healthcare for our community.

FEATURE1.TITLE: Patient-Centered Care
FEATURE1.DESCRIPTION: We believe in personalized care, focusing on your needs and preferences to provide the best possible experience.

FEATURE2.TITLE: Verified Specialists
FEATURE2.DESCRIPTION: Every doctor on our platform is vetted and credentialed, so you can book with confidence.

FEATURE3.TITLE: Simple Online Booking
FEATURE3.DESCRIPTION: Find the right specialist and book your appointment in minutes, no phone calls required.

WHY_CHOOSE.DESCRIPTION: We make finding and booking the right doctor simple, fast and stress-free.

SERVICES.HEADING: Our services
SERVICES.SUBHEADING: Comprehensive care across every specialty, in one place.

DERMATOLOGY.TITLE: Dermatology & Skin Care
DERMATOLOGY.DESCRIPTION: Skin, hair and nail care from experienced dermatologists, from checkups to treatment.

DENTAL.TITLE: Dental Care & Implants
DENTAL.DESCRIPTION: From routine cleanings to implants, backed by top-rated dental specialists.

CARDIOLOGY.TITLE: Cardiology Diagnostics
CARDIOLOGY.DESCRIPTION: Heart health screenings and diagnostics with experienced cardiologists.

PEDIATRICS.TITLE: Pediatrics & Family
PEDIATRICS.DESCRIPTION: Caring, family-focused pediatric specialists for every stage of childhood.

GYNECOLOGY.TITLE: Gynecology & Women's Health
GYNECOLOGY.DESCRIPTION: Confidential, attentive care from experienced gynecologists at every life stage.

ORTHOPEDICS.TITLE: Orthopedics & Joint Care
ORTHOPEDICS.DESCRIPTION: Diagnosis and treatment for joints, bones and mobility, from sprains to implants.

NEUROLOGY.TITLE: Neurology & Brain Health
NEUROLOGY.DESCRIPTION: Specialist care for headaches, nerve conditions and long-term brain health.

GENETICS.TITLE: Genetic Testing
GENETICS.DESCRIPTION: Advanced screening to understand your health risks and plan ahead with confidence.
